study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative trajectories of R 1 , R 2 *, and magnetic susceptibility in basal ganglia on healthy ageing

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian Process Regression (non-parametric) from PCNToolkit used to compute normative trajectories as a function of age.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Utilising the non-  parametric Gaussian Process Regression model to derive the normative trajectories

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Median qMRI metrics (R1, R2*, magnetic susceptibility χ) per subcortical ROI; subcortical tissue volumes normalized by intracranial brain volume.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text:
the median qMRI (R 1 ,  R 2 *, and χ )  values  were  calculated  for  each  subcortical  grey matter  structure.

The tissue volumes of all subcortical ROIs were also extracted  and  normalised  by  the  intracranial  brain  volume.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: GLM regressors: Age, Age^2, Sex, and left/right Hemisphere; GPR trajectories modeled as a function of age after sex and hemisphere correction.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text:
The design matrix comprised  four  regressors:  Age,  Age 2 ,  Sex,  and  (left-  / right-  ) Hemisphere:

Gaussian  Process  Regression  (GRP) ... was used to compute the normative trajectory of the sex- and hemispheric-  corrected qMRI metrics  as  a  function  of  age
